ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Given the figure, the line $y=x+1$ intersects the line $y=ax+b$ at point $A(m,3)$. What is the solution set of the inequality $x+1<ax+b$ with respect to $x$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:}

Given that the line $y=x+1$ intersects the line $y=ax+b$ at point $A(2,3)$,\\
$\therefore m+1=3$,\\
Solving this gives: $m=2$,\\
$\therefore A(2,3)$,\\
$\therefore$ the solution set of the inequality $x+1<ax+b$ with respect to $x$ is $\boxed{x<2}$.
